ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Body text, hairline borders, and rule lines — the dominant structural color used everywhere text and dividers are drawn

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary page canvas and base background for gallery and intro spreads

linen-mist.$description: Linen Mist — Warm light-gray surface for secondary spreads and subtle tonal shifts between sections

paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Warm off-white alt canvas for soft tonal contrast against Bone White

chalk-gray.$description: Chalk Gray — Muted helper text, secondary labels, and low-emphasis borders

haze-blue.$description: Haze Blue — Cool gray-blue tint for quiet borders and subdued type, balancing the warm earth tones

slate-blue.$description: Slate Blue — Dusty blue-gray accent for heading type and project labels

sky-mist.$description: Sky Mist — Light dusty blue for heading type and border rules — the coolest note in the palette

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Soft lavender-blue for heading copy and delicate dividers

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Saturated muted teal for heading type — the strongest cool accent in the system

sage.$description: Sage — Muted green accent for tag labels and short heading runs

olive.$description: Olive — Warm gray-olive for heading type and project titles — anchors the earth-tone half of the palette

moss.$description: Moss — Darker olive for emphasized heading type and link rules, reading as near-black with warmth

ochre.$description: Ochre — Golden mustard for full-bleed project backgrounds and accent headings — a signature warm note

ember-rust.$description: Ember Rust — Full-bleed intro section background — the signature terracotta that defines the brand's cover moment

lava.$description: Lava — Vivid orange punctuation for accent text and graphic highlights against muted grounds

blush.$description: Blush — Dusty pink used as the dominant hairline border color across the entire UI — the single most repeated chromatic color

rose-ash.$description: Rose Ash — Muted rose-gray for heading type and link borders, a softer companion to Blush

clay.$description: Clay — Warm taupe for heading rules and type — the bridge between the pinks and the earth tones

hanae.$description: Primary custom display and body serif. Carries the site's editorial identity. Used for hero headlines at 62–68px with extreme positive tracking (~0.4em), for body copy at 16–20px, and for tiny parenthesized section tags at 10–11px. The custom typeface's swash and discretionary ligature features are switched on for a handwritten inscriptional quality. Weight stays 400–500 even at display sizes — the scale and tracking carry the voice, not boldness.

open-sans.$description: Secondary sans for occasional subhead and hero-supporting text where a cleaner geometric voice is needed alongside the serif. Used sparingly — the serif does the structural work.
